en-GB.longDescription:
Free Download Manager for Windows, macOS, Android, and Linux allows you to adjust traffic usage, organise downloads, control file priorities for torrents, efficiently download large files and resume broken downloads.
FDM can boost all your downloads up to 10 times, process media files of various popular formats, drag and drop URLs right from a web browser as well as simultaneously download multiple files!

en-US.description: Free Download Manager (FDM for short) is a free, efficient, and comprehensive solution for managing all your downloads.

en-US.name: Free Download Manager
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Improved integration with web browsers.
- Support of downloading from file:// URLs.
- Minor interface improvements.
- Android: batch downloads support.
- Android: improved built-in web browser.
- Fixed: crash when adding a magnet download in some cases.
- Fixed: minor bugs.

zh-CN.description: Free Download Manager（简称 FDM）是一款免费、高效且全面的下载管理解决方案，可帮助您管理所有下载任务。
zh-CN.longDescription:
适用于 Windows、macOS、Android 和 Linux 的免费下载管理器可让您调整流量使用情况、管理下载任务、控制 torrent 文件的优先级，高效下载大文件并恢复中断的下载。
FDM 可将您的所有下载速度提升至最高 10 倍，处理多种主流格式的媒体文件，直接从浏览器拖放网址链接，并支持同时下载多个文件！
我们的互联网下载管理器兼容最流行的浏览器：Google Chrome、Mozilla Firefox、Microsoft Edge 和 Internet Explorer。
